description: You create a Large hand of shimmering magical energy in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand is an object with AC 20, Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum, and no occupied space. When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and cause Clenched Fist, Forceful Hand, Grasping Hand, or Interposing Hand. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot, Clenched Fist and Grasping Hand damage increase.

attachment.description: unoccupied space that the caster can see within range

name: Arcane Hand
